title: Infrastructure as code (IaC): Cloud Development Kit (CDK)

cues.en: Hello and welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today we're talking about the Cloud Development Kit, or CDK.
cues.zh: 今天談 Cloud Development Kit，CDK。

cues.en: The CDK allows you to program or create infrastructure in the programming language that you're programming your application in, in which you're programming your application.
cues.zh: 它讓你用編寫應用程式的同一程式語言，建立基礎設施。

cues.en: What a tongue twister.
cues.zh: 好繞口。

cues.en: Anyway, so a CDK, in a nutshell, let's say you're programming an application in Python.
cues.zh: 簡單說，假設用 Python 寫應用。

cues.en: Well, then you have to write your application in Python and at the same time create your infrastructure separately.
cues.zh: 原本要寫 Python，同時另外建立基礎設施。

cues.en: That's a bit inconvenient.
cues.zh: 不方便。

cues.en: Well, that's where CDK comes in.
cues.zh: CDK 就派上用場。

cues.en: Let's say you need an EC2 instance and an S3 bucket for your Python application.
cues.zh: 假設 Python 應用需要 EC2 與 S3。

cues.en: Let's say you're doing something with video processing or something like that.
cues.zh: 例如影片處理。

cues.en: Well, using the CDK, you can actually write in your Python code the resources that you need.
cues.zh: 用 CDK，可在 Python 程式裡寫所需資源。

cues.en: You can integrate them into your Python code in Python, and then the CDK will convert that into a CloudFormation template, which means you can actually write
cues.zh: 整合到 Python，CDK 再轉成 CloudFormation 範本，也就是能在寫應用的同時，

cues.en: and deploy your AWS resources at the same time as you write your application code.
cues.zh: 撰寫與部署 AWS 資源。

cues.en: CloudFormation will create a stack and the rest is history.
cues.zh: CloudFormation 建堆疊，後面就熟悉了。

cues.en: We know how that works.
cues.zh: 知道如何運作。

cues.en: It creates all these resources as infrastructure as code.
cues.zh: 以基礎設施即程式碼建立全部資源。

cues.en: So there we go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: CDK is the link between the programming language that you're using and the AWS resources that you need.
cues.zh: CDK 是程式語言與 AWS 資源間的橋梁。

cues.en: So here's an example of some code in Python.
cues.zh: 這是 Python 範例。

cues.en: CDK supports different programming languages, such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, C# and others.
cues.zh: 也支援 JavaScript、TypeScript、Python、C# 等。

cues.en: And you're able to define your infrastructure that way.
cues.zh: 可用這方式定義基礎設施。

cues.en: So here we can see that we're creating an Amazon S3 bucket, and here we're creating an Amazon EC2 instance.
cues.zh: 這裡建 S3，這裡建 EC2。

cues.en: So there we go. That's pretty much how CDK works.
cues.zh: 大致就是 CDK 運作。

cues.en: So whenever on the exam you hear something about incorporating cloud infrastructure into your code or defining cloud resources in Python or JavaScript
cues.zh: 考試看到把雲端基礎設施整合程式，或用 Python、JavaScript 定義資源，

cues.en: and so on, then think CDK.
cues.zh: 就想到 CDK。

cues.en: So there's a quick summary of what we discussed and I look forward to seeing you next time.
cues.zh: 快速整理如這裡，期待下次見。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受雲端的樂趣吧。
